newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM FORMS NEW CARGO MANAGEMENT UNIT.
newsitem.headline: KLM FORMS NEW CARGO MANAGEMENT UNIT.

text.p: KLM is in the process of creating a new cargo capacity-management unit, a KLM spokesman said on Thursday, speaking from the airline's headquarters.
The "Rederij" (shipping) unit will be operational on April 1, 1997.
KLM operations and sales are being brought together under the new unit which is aiming to match the cargo space available with demand, he said.
He denied that the formation of the new business unit was related to KLM's annual results performance last year when the carrier blamed over capacity in the cargo market for disappointing results.
"We have already taken measures concerning the cargo capacity. Last year capacity growth was in double-digits, now it is in line with demand, " he stated.
"The unit will be responsible for capacity management and for the optimisation of income out of cargo," he added.
There will be six business units within KLM when the Rederij unit is operational.
"Bringing the two disciplines together under the unit means there is much more accountability. The unit will be a separate profit centre with its own targets," he added.
He said that it is too early to say about the exact staff numbers to be employed in the unit.
